work.title: Workshop floor

work.emptyBuildBody: Bikes on open manufacturing orders show up here. Create an MO and add bikes to start a batch.

batchBuild.intro: Build several identical bikes at once — the parts come from the recipe; you only enter each bike's frame number and identifiers here.

identifierDialog.title: Register identifier
identifierDialog.description: Identifiers can be added at any point in the bike's lifecycle — missing ones don't block status changes.

scan.title: Scan QR sticker
scan.pageHint: Point the back camera at any Jensen bike sticker. The page will navigate as soon as the code is recognised.
scan.cameraFailedBody: {message}. Check the browser permission, or paste a frame number / bike URL below.
scan.manualLabel: Or enter a frame number / paste a URL
scan.installIos: Tired of allowing the camera every time? Tap the share button in Safari, then Add to Home Screen. Launching from the home-screen icon remembers the camera permission and feels like a native app.
scan.installAndroid: Tired of allowing the camera every time? Open your browser menu and pick Install app (or Add to Home Screen). Launched from the home-screen icon the camera permission sticks.
